verdict.rationale: Deel's marketing and product docs explicitly state it runs payroll for 'employees, contractors, and EOR workers' from one unified platform, and its API supports creating contractor contracts alongside broader payroll/people data. Community complaints in the pack concern unrelated issues (marketing spam, forced wallet payments) and don't dispute the core multi-worker-type payroll capability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of actual US W-2 employee payroll processing (tax filings, W-2 forms) beyond marketing copy.
